experiment: E4 — statistical stability and confidence-interval synthesis
amendment_reason: Add a narrowly scoped Git LF-checkout compatibility rule after preflight established that E3 final-validator CSV hashes were recorded as CRLF bytes while .gitattributes enforces LF checkout; no metric, threshold, result, or upstream artifact is changed.
objective: Audit and synthesize uncertainty, paired effects, metric coverage, and reporting scope from frozen canonical E1–E3 artifacts. No experiment rerun, threshold selection, or modification of upstream results is permitted.
scope: Offline statistical synthesis of controlled-emulation artifacts. E4 does not measure DNS cache-poisoning success, ASR, real IP fragmentation, resolver end-to-end behavior, latency, throughput, CPU, memory, or deployment performance.
forbidden_actions: rerun E1, E2, or E3 experiments
read E3 held-out decision data for aggregation, threshold selection, or retuning
modify E3 protocol, validation grid, locked threshold, test results, or upstream artifacts
pool E2 and E3 as statistically independent studies
infer ASR, poisoning prevention, latency, throughput, CPU, or memory from detector-alert metrics
omit unfavorable failure-probe or boundary results

raw_input_access.default: Read frozen result, summary, protocol, manifest, and validator artifacts only.
raw_input_access.upstream_raw_data: Forbidden unless a separately registered, read-only CI audit is required.
raw_input_access.E3_held_out_decisions: Forbidden for aggregation, selection, retuning, or any new result generation.

input_hash_policy.default: Every registered artifact must match the frozen SHA-256 byte-for-byte.

git_lf_checkout_compatibility.required_checkout_state: The current CSV must contain LF line endings only, consistent with repository .gitattributes '*.csv text eol=lf'.
git_lf_checkout_compatibility.pass_condition: Only if converting every current LF byte to CRLF reproduces the exact frozen SHA-256 recorded in e3_validation.json. All other E3 validator artifacts remain byte-exact.
git_lf_checkout_compatibility.reporting: Record both filesystem SHA-256 and frozen expected SHA-256 with verification_status=pass_git_lf_checkout_equivalent.

E3.note: E3 is a new 60/20/20 repartition of canonical E2; it must not be described as K=20.

inference.effect_size_priority: Report estimates and confidence intervals; p-values are optional and never replace effect sizes.
inference.E1_method: Use the frozen run-level/cluster-bootstrap method for each condition; decision windows within a run are not IID.
inference.E2_method: Use the frozen paired-trace bootstrap method with 5000 resamples.
inference.E3_method: Use the frozen stratified paired-trace bootstrap method with 5000 resamples across the eight primary cells.
inference.tail_latency_method: Only if real per-run latency measurements exist; use run-level or hierarchical bootstrap. Otherwise report not measured.

cross_experiment_rules.E2_E3_dependence: E3 is a 60/20/20 repartition of the canonical E2 decision dataset. E2 and E3 may be compared descriptively but must not be pooled or treated as independent replications.
cross_experiment_rules.metric_semantics: E2/E3 attack-alert and benign-trigger are controlled synthetic detector rates. They are not ASR or end-to-end poisoning outcomes.
cross_experiment_rules.missing_metrics_policy: Report not_measured or not_supported; never impute.

metric_reporting_rules.mean_median: Report mean and median only when the corresponding run- or pair-level distribution exists; never reconstruct a median from an aggregate mean or CI.
metric_reporting_rules.zero_rate: When reporting an observed zero rate, include numerator, denominator, CI method, and independent-unit caveat; never interpret observed zero as the true rate.
metric_reporting_rules.unfavorable_results: Failure probes, operating boundaries, and heterogeneous cells must be retained alongside macro summaries.

validation_requirements: verify hashes and upstream validator PASS status
verify every reported metric has source artifact, source hash, scope, independent unit, and CI method
verify observed independent-unit counts against the registered run_count_audit
verify E2 and E3 are not statistically pooled
verify ASR and runtime metrics are explicitly not measured where unsupported
verify default aggregation did not read raw upstream decision data
verify no upstream protocol, threshold, or result was modified
